title: There's A New Shelf In The Cage

scenes.narration: There is a shelf in the lost property cage that was not there yesterday. It is empty.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single empty steel shelf in the middle of a wire mesh cage full of crowded shelves of tagged belongings, the empty one bare and clean, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: IT'S AS LONG AS I AM TALL
scenes.narration: It is longer than the others. I lay down beside it on the floor to measure it. It is exactly as long as I am tall.
scenes.imagePrompt: A person in a grey cardigan lying on a concrete floor beside a low steel shelf, seen from above, arms by their sides, face turned away and in shadow, no face visible, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: There is a tag tied to the end of it, in my handwriting. Reserved. Nothing else.
scenes.imagePrompt: A brown luggage tag tied with string to the end of a bare steel shelf, swinging slightly, lit by a single bulb, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: THE LOG HAS A NUMBER FOR IT
scenes.narration: The log has a number for it. Item four hundred and fifty. The description is blank. They are leaving it to me.
scenes.imagePrompt: A ledger open at a new page with one numbered row and the rest of the line left blank, a fountain pen beside it, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain
